program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((objs (sort (objects g 0) (lambda (a b) (< (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
         (palette (list 2 4 8)))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list objs)] [i (in-naturals)])
      (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) (list-ref palette i)))))
